## When to load this skill

Audit a strategy against the seven deadly quant sins, compute the Deflated Sharpe Ratio and the probability of backtest overfitting, and decide whether a result survives its own trial count.

## Triggers

`audit`, `overfitting`, `deflated sharpe`, `dsr`, `pbo`, `lookahead bias`, `data snooping`, `too good to be true`, `review my backtest`
